question.text:
The coordination number of Th in $\mathrm{K}_{4}\left[\mathrm{Th}\left(\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{4}\right)_{4}\left(\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}\right)_{2}\right]$ is:

$\left(\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{4}^{2-}=\right.$ oxalato $)$

solution.text: $\mathrm{K}_{4}\left[\mathrm{Th}\left(\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{4}\right)_{4}\left(\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}\right)_{2}\right]$ $\mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{4}^{2-}$ (oxalato) : bidentate ligand $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ (aqua): monodentate $\therefore$ Co-ordination no. of Th $=2 \times 4+2=10$
